# Paired effects (generated by `scripts/audit_paired.py`)

Difference = method − reference for the same condition and seed; mean [95% t-interval over seeds]. Percent reduction = 100 × (mean(reference) − mean(method)) / mean(reference); the denominator is the reference method's mean over seeds.

**Scope of the intervals.** The truth trajectories are fixed and only detection noise, misses and clutter change with the seed. Each interval therefore describes simulation variability on one fixed traffic window. It says nothing about other days or airports; for that see the separate rows per scenario.
